recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, soft-focus portrait of a woman with curly hair, framed by a single vibrant orange maple leaf in the lower right and a list of names in the upper right. The composition uses a warm, earthy color palette with a prominent bold serif title at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The maple leaf acts as a visual counterweight to the subject's face.
The subject's gaze is directed slightly off-camera, creating a contemplative mood.
The text block in the upper right follows the curve of the subject's hair.
coreInvariants: Single orange maple leaf with visible veins
Soft, diffused lighting on the face
Tight headshot crop cutting off the top of the head
High-contrast black serif title at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies the left two-thirds of the frame in a tight close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold title at the bottom center-left and the orange leaf in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the title, then swings right to the leaf and up through the list of names.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject's hair and the text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and dark brown hair provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black typography provides sharp contrast against the light skin and background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and red of the maple leaf provide a singular pop of color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the facial highlights, low value in the hair and shadows, with high saturation reserved for the leaf.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The title features slightly compressed tracking to emphasize its horizontal weight.

composition.relationshipToImage: Anchors the base of the portrait

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for secondary details.
graphicDevices: Soft gradient vignette on the right edge

preserve: Italicized subtitle above the main title

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman Bold or Georgia
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical high-contrast serif look of the title.
Provides a clean, modern contrast for the metadata list.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus, warm-toned portrait of a woman with dark curly hair looking slightly to the side. In the bottom right corner, place a single, detailed orange-red maple leaf. The right side of the image should fade into a light, creamy background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, black serif title in all caps at the bottom. Above it, add a small line of italicized serif text. In the top right corner, add a right-aligned list of names in a clean sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the maple leaf vibrant and distinct?
Is the title font a high-contrast serif?
Is the lighting on the face soft and warm?
Is the text in the top right right-aligned?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the orange in the leaf
Amount of blur in the hair
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the leaf does not obscure the main title.
Check that the right-aligned text is legible against the background.
Verify the serif title feels grounded at the bottom of the frame.
Confirm the overall mood is nostalgic and warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Single Seasonal Element + Bold Serif Base + Right-Aligned Metadata List
